notice: All organizations, account facts, activity and results are synthetic. These are proposed GTM workflows, not deployed employer systems or measured company performance.
title: Find the shop, understand the quoting bottleneck.
intro: A proposed sales workbench for Forgepoint: turn manufacturer research into a specific discovery brief and a pilot the customer can evaluate.
queueIntro: Industry fit is a starting point. A useful brief explains the current quoting process, who owns it and what would make a pilot worth testing.
workbenchIntro: Change the workflow evidence and pilot prerequisites. A promising estimate cannot substitute for a confirmed process owner or an approved sample.
firstBuild: A quoting-workflow brief that supports founder-led sales
firstBody: Connect the shop’s process, quote volume and current tools with an accountable sponsor, an approved sample and clear pilot criteria. Preserve unknowns instead of inventing shop rules.

metricsTitle: Size the workflow before promising a result.
metricsIntro: Estimate administrative effort from a synthetic RFQ cohort. This is workload sizing, not a time-saving claim or a quotation for manufactured parts.
metricsNotes: RFQs per week × administrative minutes per RFQ ÷ 60 = estimated weekly administrative hours.
A pilot should measure the actual baseline, exception rate, reviewer effort and quote turnaround before forecasting a benefit.
Scope approval, data access and customer commitments remain human decisions. This portfolio approves none of them.

experiments.name: Process-specific discovery
experiments.hypothesis: A researched quoting bottleneck makes the first discussion more useful.
experiments.treatment: Reviewed process hypothesis and an explicit question
experiments.primary: Held qualified discovery per target account
experiments.guardrail: Incorrect process assumptions and unwanted outreach
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

experiments.name: Pilot acceptance checklist
experiments.hypothesis: A shared definition of a useful pilot reduces unclear handoffs.
experiments.treatment: Named sponsor, approved sample and success criteria
experiments.primary: Pilots with an accepted evaluation plan
experiments.guardrail: Review burden and unapproved data requests
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

roadmap.title: Learn one manufacturing segment
roadmap.body: Map the quoting journey with sales. Define account identity, research sources and the discovery brief for one segment.
roadmap.measure: Verified process owners and accepted discovery briefs

roadmap.title: Support founder-led pilots
roadmap.body: Add sample approval, success criteria and proposal follow-up. Keep unresolved access and commercial questions visible.
roadmap.measure: Time to accepted evaluation plan and overdue next steps

roadmap.title: Scale the useful parts
roadmap.body: Compare qualified opportunities by segment and improve CRM deduplication, retry handling and account ownership.
roadmap.measure: Qualified pipeline, research accuracy and workflow adoption
